zdravo.mnemonic: A friend spots you and shouts "BRAVO!" — no, it's ZDRAVO, just a cheerful hello!
zdravo.components: informal greeting (hi/hello), also used for goodbye among friends · formal = dober dan

živjo.mnemonic: You greet the butler casually: "JEEVES, YO!" — ŽIVJO, hi!
živjo.components: informal hi or bye among friends · from živ 'alive' · formal = dober dan

dober dan.mnemonic: A polite doe and a bear tip their hats to Dan: "DOBER DAN — good day!"
dober dan.components: formal greeting used from late morning to evening · morning: dobro jutro · evening: dober večer

dobro jutro.mnemonic: The alarm rings and a voice says: "Good! YOU are TRULY up early" — DOBRO JUTRO!
dobro jutro.components: greeting until about 9 a.m. · jutro = morning (neuter) · later in the day: dober dan

dober večer.sounds_like: DO-ber ve-ČER ≈ "DOH-ber veh-CHAIR" → "a very good chair"
dober večer.mnemonic: In the evening you finally sink into a good armchair — a "VE-CHAIR": DOBER VEČER!
dober večer.components: greeting from about 6 p.m. · večer = evening (masculine) · 'in the evening' = zvečer

lahko noč.mnemonic: Before bed you wish "LUCK, OH!" and cut a NOTCH in the bedpost — LAHKO NOČ, good night!
lahko noč.components: said when going to bed · noč = night (feminine) · 'at night' = ponoči

nasvidenje.mnemonic: Waving at the door you sing "Nah, see ya then-ya!" — NASVIDENJE, goodbye!
nasvidenje.components: goodbye (neutral/formal); literally 'till we see again' · informal: adijo or zdravo

adijo.mnemonic: Like Spanish ADIOS with a Slovenian twist — ADIJO, bye!

hvala.mnemonic: You value the help, so you say HVALA — thank you!
hvala.components: interjection · 'thank you very much' = hvala lepa · usual reply: prosim

hvala lepa.mnemonic: You VALUE the help so much that you LEAP for joy — HVALA LEPA, thank you very much!
hvala lepa.components: lepa = 'beautiful' (from lep): literally 'beautiful thanks' · also: najlepša hvala
hvala lepa.example_en: Thank you very much for the gift.

prosim.mnemonic: Politely ask the phone-shop pro: "PRO, SIM card, please!" — PROSIM means please.
prosim.components: means 'please', 'you're welcome' (reply to hvala) and 'pardon?' · 'a coffee, please' = kavo, prosim

ni za kaj.sounds_like: NI za KAJ ≈ "nee zah KYE" → "knee, the kite"
ni za kaj.mnemonic: Literally "it isn't for anything": there is nothing to thank me for — NI ZA KAJ!
ni za kaj.components: reply to hvala · ni = is not, za = for, kaj = what · also: prosim
ni za kaj.example_zh: Hvala za pomoč! Ni za kaj.
ni za kaj.example_en: Thanks for the help! You're welcome.

ja.mnemonic: Just say "yeah" with a relaxed jaw — JA, yes!
ja.components: particle · 'yes, please' = ja, prosim · opposite: ne

da.mnemonic: A firm, formal nod: DA — yes. In "vem, da …" it also means THAT.
da.components: formal or neutral 'yes' (everyday: ja) · also 'that' joining sentences: vem, da … = I know that …

ne.mnemonic: The judge votes "NAY!" — NE means no.
ne.components: means 'no' and 'not' (before verbs) · 'I don't understand' = ne razumem

oprostite.mnemonic: You knock over the tennis pro's tea — "Oh, pro's tea! OPROSTITE, sorry!"
oprostite.components: formal / plural form · informal (to one friend) = oprosti · also used to get attention
oprostite.example_en: Excuse me, where is the station?

oprosti.mnemonic: You knock over a friend's cold drink: "OH, FROSTY — sorry!" OPROSTI.
oprosti.components: informal 'sorry, excuse me' to one person you say ti to · formal or to several: oprostite

v redu.mnemonic: Everything stands neatly in a row: V REDU literally means "in order" — OK!
v redu.components: 'OK, all right' · red = order, row · 'is that OK?' = je to v redu?

kako si.mnemonic: Over a cup of COCOA you lean in: "SEE, how are you?" — KAKO SI?
kako si.components: informal 'how are you?' to one person · si = you are · usual reply: dobro, hvala

kako ste.mnemonic: You offer a guest COCOA: "STAY a while — how are you?" KAKO STE?
kako ste.components: formal or plural 'how are you?' · ste = you are (formal/plural) · informal: kako si
kako ste.example_en: Good day, sir. How are you?

dobro.mnemonic: Your bro gives a thumbs up: "DOH, BRO, all good!" — DOBRO.
dobro.components: adverb 'well, good' · reply to kako si? · the adjective: dober (m), dobra (f)

slabo.mnemonic: Lying on the sofa like a SLOB, OH, you feel SLABO — bad.
slabo.components: adverb 'badly, bad' · opposite of dobro · 'I feel sick' = slabo mi je

dobrodošli.mnemonic: DOBRO (good) + DOŠLI (you've arrived): good that you came — welcome!
dobrodošli.components: 'welcome' to several people or formally · to a man: dobrodošel · to a woman: dobrodošla

na zdravje.mnemonic: Glasses up: "To HEALTH!" — NA ZDRAVJE, from zdrav = healthy.
na zdravje.components: 'cheers' when toasting, also 'bless you' after a sneeze · zdravje = health (neuter)

dober tek.mnemonic: Your robot chef beeps before dinner: "Good TECH … DOBER TEK!" — enjoy your meal.
dober tek.components: said before a meal · tek = appetite · reply: hvala, enako (thanks, you too)

jaz.mnemonic: I love jazz so much that I AM jazz — JAZ means I.
jaz.components: personal pronoun 'I' · often dropped because the verb shows the person: (jaz) sem = I am

ti.mnemonic: Pointing at a friend: "Tea for YOU!" — TI means you.
ti.components: informal 'you' (one person, friends/family) · formal or plural = vi

on.mnemonic: HE owns everything in sight — ON!
on.components: 'he' · often left out, as the verb shows the person: (on) je = he is · 'him' = njega, ga

ona.mnemonic: SHE shakes her head: "OH, NAH!" — ONA.

ono.components: 'it' for neuter nouns (dekle, okno, mesto) · 'it is' = (ono) je

mi.mnemonic: Not just ME — me and my friends together are MI: we!
mi.components: 'we' (three or more) · just two of us: midva, midve · (mi) smo = we are

vi.mnemonic: Point a V of two fingers at all of YOU — VI!
vi.components: 'you' to several people, and polite 'you' to one person · (vi) ste = you are · informal: ti

oni.mnemonic: THEY all tripped at once: "OH, my KNEE!" — ONI.
oni.components: 'they' for men or mixed groups · only women: one · (oni) so = they are

one.mnemonic: THEY, the three sisters, answer together: "OH, NAY!" — ONE.
one.components: 'they' for women only (or feminine nouns) · men or mixed: oni

midva.mnemonic: MI (we) + DVA (two) = just the two of us: MIDVA!
midva.components: dual 'we two' (men or mixed) · two women: midve · verb in the dual: midva sva
midva.example_en: The two of us are friends.

ime.mnemonic: Your NAME is what people AIM at when they call you — IME.
ime.components: neuter noun · 'my name is …' = ime mi je … or moje ime je … · genitive: imena

priimek.mnemonic: PRI (next to) + IME (name): the name that comes next to your first name — the surname.
priimek.components: masculine noun · built on ime (name) · Slovenia's most common surname is Novak

moški.mnemonic: A MAN in the mosh pit holding a big KEY — MOŠKI.
moški.components: 'man' (also the adjective 'male, men's') · plural: moški · woman: ženska

ženska.mnemonic: A calm WOMAN dancing to Zen ska music — ŽENSKA.

otrok.mnemonic: The CHILD points and shouts: "OH, TRUCK!" — OTROK.
otrok.components: masculine noun 'child' · plural: otroci · 'we have two children' = imava dva otroka
otrok.example_en: The child is playing in the garden.

fant.mnemonic: The BOY is his band's biggest FAN — FANT; it also means boyfriend.
fant.components: masculine noun 'boy, guy; boyfriend' · plural: fantje

dekle.mnemonic: A GIRL waves from the ship's DECK — DEKLE!
dekle.components: neuter noun (!) 'girl; girlfriend' · genitive and plural: dekleta
dekle.example_en: The girl is reading a book.

človek.mnemonic: Chloe walked away from the WRECK unhurt — a tough HUMAN, ČLOVEK.
človek.components: masculine noun 'person, human being' · irregular plural: ljudje (people)

ljudje.mnemonic: PEOPLE at a concert are LOUD — YEAH! LJUDJE.
ljudje.components: plural of človek · 'many people' = veliko ljudi (genitive)

prijatelj.mnemonic: Your friend can't stop telling you about his YACHT — pree-YACHT-tell, PRIJATELJ!
prijatelj.components: masculine noun · female friend = prijateljica · final -lj sounds like a plain l

prijateljica.mnemonic: PRIJATELJ (friend) + the female ending -ICA = a female friend.
prijateljica.components: feminine of prijatelj · -ica makes many female nouns (učiteljica, natakarica)

gospod.mnemonic: A GENTLEMAN in a top hat steps out of a GOOSE POD — GOSPOD!
gospod.components: masculine noun 'Mr; gentleman; sir' · gospod Novak = Mr Novak

gospa.mnemonic: The LADY relaxes at the GOOSE SPA — GOSPA.
gospa.components: feminine noun 'Mrs; lady; madam' · gospa Novak = Mrs Novak

gospodična.mnemonic: GOSPA (lady) made smaller with -IČNA: a young lady — Miss.
gospodična.components: feminine noun 'Miss; young lady' · old-fashioned today; usually gospa

sosed.mnemonic: "SO I SAID …" — your chatty NEIGHBOUR, SOSED, never stops talking.
sosed.components: masculine noun 'neighbour' · a woman: soseda · plural: sosedje

soseda.mnemonic: SOSED plus -A: the woman next door — SOSEDA.
soseda.components: feminine of sosed · the ending -a often marks a woman

star.mnemonic: An OLD film STAR — STAR means old!
star.components: adjective 'old' (f. stara, n. staro) · age: star sem 30 let = I'm 30

mlad.components: adjective 'young' (f. mlada, n. mlado) · opposite: star

leto.mnemonic: At the end of every YEAR you LET GO and start again — LETO. Summer is PO-LETJE.
leto.components: neuter noun 'year' · '5 years' = pet let · this year = letos

družina.mnemonic: Uncle DREW and aunt GINA come to every FAMILY dinner — DRUŽINA.
družina.components: feminine noun 'family' · 'in the family' = v družini

mama.mnemonic: Easy one: every baby's first "mama" calls MOM in Slovenian too.
mama.components: feminine noun · 'my mom' = moja mama · 'dad' = ati or oče

oče.mnemonic: Father sinks into his favourite armchair with a sigh: "Oh, CHAIR!" — that's OČE.
oče.components: masculine noun · genitive očeta · 'my father' = moj oče · casual 'dad' = ati

ati.mnemonic: Little kids shout "ATI!" the way English kids shout "Daddy!"
ati.components: masculine noun, everyday 'dad' (more formal: oče) · 'with dad' = z atijem

starši.mnemonic: From STAR 'old': the older ones who raised you — your PARENTS, STARŠI.

brat.mnemonic: Your little BROTHER is a real BRAT — BRAT!
brat.components: masculine noun 'brother' · plural: bratje · two brothers = dva brata

sestra.mnemonic: SESTRA is just SISTER said quickly.

sin.example_zh: Moj sin je star pet let.
sin.example_en: My son is five years old.

hči.mnemonic: My DAUGHTER has an ITCHY nose — HČI!
hči.components: feminine noun 'daughter' · irregular: hčere (genitive) · also common: hčerka

mož.mnemonic: My HUSBAND MOE is a real man — MOŽ.
mož.components: masculine noun 'husband; man' · plural: možje · wife: žena

babica.mnemonic: GRANDMA always holds the BABY — BABICA.
babica.components: feminine noun 'grandmother' · informally: babi or stara mama

dedek.mnemonic: GRANDPA is DAD's dad, resting on the DECK — DEDEK.
dedek.components: masculine noun 'grandfather' · informally: dedi or stari ata

stric.mnemonic: Your cool UNCLE knows all the STREETS — STRIC.

teta.mnemonic: AUNTIE always turns up at TEA time — TETA.

bratranec.mnemonic: Not quite your BRAT (brother), but close: a BRATRANEC, a cousin.
bratranec.components: masculine noun 'male cousin' · built on brat · female cousin: sestrična

sestrična.mnemonic: Almost a SESTRA (sister): a SESTRIČNA, a female cousin.
sestrična.components: feminine noun 'female cousin' · built on sestra · male cousin: bratranec

vnuk.mnemonic: Grandma's NEW KID in the family — VNUK, grandson.
vnuk.components: masculine noun 'grandson' · plural vnuki also means 'grandchildren' · granddaughter: vnukinja

dojenček.mnemonic: From DOJITI 'to breastfeed': the little one who still drinks milk — DOJENČEK, a baby.
dojenček.components: masculine noun 'baby' · the ending -ček makes things small and cute

poročen.mnemonic: POOR ROCHEN is MARRIED now — no more late nights! POROČEN.
poročen.components: adjective 'married' (f. poročena) · 'to get married' = poročiti se

samski.mnemonic: SAM skis alone every weekend — he's SINGLE: SAMSKI (sam = alone).

nič.mnemonic: You look in the NICHE and find NOTHING — NIČ, zero.
nič.components: 'nothing; zero' · Slovenian uses a double negative: nič ne vem = I know nothing

ena.mnemonic: Anna always finishes first — she's number ONE, ENA!
ena.components: 'one' with feminine nouns · masculine en, neuter eno · 'one coffee, please' = eno kavo, prosim

dva.mnemonic: TWO divas fight over one microphone — DVA!
dva.components: 'two' with masculine nouns (dva brata) · feminine/neuter: dve · nouns take the dual form

tri.mnemonic: THREE trees in a row: tree, tree, TRI!
tri.components: 'three' with feminine/neuter nouns · masculine nominative: trije (trije fantje)

štiri.mnemonic: FOUR girls, each planting a tree: "SHE-TREE" — ŠTIRI.
štiri.components: 'four' · štirje for men (štirje fantje), štiri otherwise (štiri hiše)

pet.mnemonic: FIVE PETS in one small flat — PET!
pet.components: 'five' · from five on the noun goes into the genitive plural: pet let, pet evrov

šest.mnemonic: SIX gold coins in a treasure CHEST — ŠEST.

sedem.mnemonic: SEVEN dwarfs, and you've SAID 'EM all by name — SEDEM.
sedem.components: 'seven' · + genitive plural: sedem dni = seven days

devet.mnemonic: NINE cats in the waiting room at THE VET — DEVET.
devet.components: 'nine' · + genitive plural: devet mesecev = nine months
devet.example_zh: Moja hči je stara devet let.
devet.example_en: My daughter is nine years old.

deset.mnemonic: A full SET of TEN fingers — DESET.
deset.components: 'ten' · tens are built on it: trideset, štirideset …

dvanajst.example_en: There are twelve children in the class.

trinajst.mnemonic: TRI (three) on ten — unlucky THIRTEEN, TRINAJST.
trinajst.example_en: My sister is thirteen years old.

petnajst.mnemonic: Five PETS sitting on ten — FIFTEEN, PETNAJST.
petnajst.components: 'fifteen' · pet + -najst · 'a quarter' of an hour is četrt
petnajst.example_en: The bus comes in fifteen minutes.

dvajset.mnemonic: DVA (two) SETS of ten — TWENTY, DVAJSET.
dvajset.components: 'twenty' · the other tens end in -deset (trideset, štirideset)

enaindvajset.mnemonic: Say it like old English "one-and-twenty": ENA IN DVAJSET.
enaindvajset.components: 'twenty-one' · the ones come first, all written as one word

sto.mnemonic: STOW a HUNDRED boxes in the attic — STO.
sto.example_en: It's a hundred kilometres to the sea.

dvesto.components: 'two hundred' · uses dve, not dva · 300 = tristo
dvesto.example_en: The bike costs two hundred euros.

tisoč.mnemonic: A THOUSAND cups of TEA — SUCH a lot! TISOČ.
tisoč.example_en: The town is a thousand years old.

milijon.mnemonic: MILIJON is simply MILLION with a J.
milijon.components: masculine noun 'million' · two million = dva milijona

prvi.mnemonic: PRVI sounds like PRIME — number one, the FIRST.
prvi.components: ordinal 'first' (f. prva, n. prvo) · first floor = prvo nadstropje

drugi.mnemonic: DREW asks for a SECOND spoon of GHEE — DRUGI.
drugi.components: 'second' and also 'other' (f. druga) · drugi ljudje = other people
drugi.example_en: I live on the second floor.

tretji.mnemonic: The THIRD TREATY was the one that worked — TRETJI.

pol.mnemonic: Snap the POLE in HALF — POL.
pol.components: 'half' · time: pol treh = half past two (literally 'half of three')

številka.mnemonic: Thieves STEAL a CAR, but you wrote down its NUMBER — ŠTEVILKA.
številka.components: feminine noun 'number' (phone, shoe size, house) · telefonska številka = phone number

dan.mnemonic: Every DAY starts at DAWN — DAN.
dan.components: masculine noun 'day' · genitive: dneva · two days = dva dneva

teden.mnemonic: A WEEK of rest in the garden of EDEN — T-EDEN!
teden.components: masculine noun 'week' · genitive: tedna · next week = naslednji teden
teden.example_en: Next week I'm going to the seaside.

mesec.mnemonic: By the end of every MONTH the flat gets MESSY — MESEC.
mesec.example_en: I have a lot of work this month.

ura.mnemonic: The clock strikes the HOUR: HOORAH! — URA.
ura.components: feminine noun 'hour; clock; o'clock' · 'what time is it?' = koliko je ura?

minuta.mnemonic: MINUTA is just MINUTE with an -a on the end.
minuta.components: feminine noun 'minute' · five minutes = pet minut

čas.components: masculine noun 'time' · 'I don't have time' = nimam časa (genitive)

jutro.mnemonic: In the MORNING YOU THROW off the blanket — JUTRO.

dopoldne.mnemonic: DO (until) + POLDNE (noon): the time until noon — late MORNING.
dopoldne.components: 'late morning, a.m.' · also used as 'in the morning': dopoldne delam
dopoldne.example_en: In the morning I'm at work.

poldne.mnemonic: POL (half) + DNE (of the day): the middle of the day — NOON.
poldne.components: neuter noun 'noon' · 'at noon' = opoldne or ob poldne
poldne.example_en: At noon we go for lunch.

popoldne.mnemonic: PO (after) + POLDNE (noon) = AFTER-NOON, word for word!
popoldne.components: 'afternoon' · also used as 'in the afternoon': popoldne grem domov
popoldne.example_en: In the afternoon I go for a walk.

večer.mnemonic: In the EVENING you sit in your favourite armchair — VE-ČER.

noč.mnemonic: Every NIGHT, a NOTCH on the bedpost — NOČ.
noč.components: feminine noun 'night' · 'at night' = ponoči · good night = lahko noč

jutri.mnemonic: TOMORROW morning YOU'll plant a TREE — JUTRI (from jutro, morning).

včeraj.mnemonic: YESTERDAY I ate French RYE bread — VČERAJ.
včeraj.components: adverb 'yesterday' · goes with the past tense: včeraj sem bil …

zdaj.mnemonic: The starter yells "ZDAJ!" and everyone runs — NOW!
zdaj.components: adverb 'now' · also sedaj (a bit more formal)

kmalu.mnemonic: "COME, LOU, the bus will be here SOON!" — KMALU.
kmalu.components: adverb 'soon' · see you soon = se vidimo kmalu

pozno.mnemonic: No time to POSE — NO, it's LATE! POZNO.

zgodaj.mnemonic: "Let'S GO, the DAY is starting!" — up EARLY, ZGODAJ.

vedno.mnemonic: ALWAYS asked to WED, ALWAYS answering NO — VEDNO.
vedno.example_en: I always drink coffee in the morning.

nikoli.mnemonic: NICOLE is NEVER on time — NIKOLI.
nikoli.components: adverb 'never' · the verb also takes ne: nikoli ne jem = I never eat

pogosto.mnemonic: He jumps on his POGO stick OFTEN — POGOSTO.

ponedeljek.mnemonic: PO (after) + NEDELJA (Sunday): the day AFTER Sunday — MONDAY.
ponedeljek.components: masculine noun 'Monday' · 'on Monday' = v ponedeljek · days take no capital letter
ponedeljek.example_en: I have an exam on Monday.

torek.mnemonic: TUESDAY, the second day: a fine day TO WRECK your diet — TOREK.
torek.components: masculine noun 'Tuesday' · from an old word for 'second' · 'on Tuesday' = v torek
torek.example_en: On Tuesday I'm going to the doctor.

sreda.mnemonic: From SREDINA 'middle': the MIDDLE of the week — WEDNESDAY.
sreda.example_en: We have a meeting on Wednesday.

četrtek.mnemonic: From ČETRTI 'fourth': the FOURTH day — THURSDAY.
četrtek.example_en: On Thursday I'm going to the cinema.

petek.mnemonic: From PET 'five': the FIFTH day — FRIDAY.
petek.example_en: On Friday evening we go out.

sobota.example_en: On Saturday I go to the market.

nedelja.mnemonic: NE (not) + DELATI (to work): the day you DON'T WORK — SUNDAY.

vikend.mnemonic: VIKEND is just WEEKEND, spelled the Slovenian way.
vikend.components: masculine noun 'weekend' · 'at the weekend' = za vikend, med vikendom
vikend.example_en: At the weekend we're going to the hills.

januar.components: masculine noun · months take no capital letter · 'in January' = januarja

marec.components: masculine noun · 'in March' = marca (the e drops out)

april.mnemonic: APRIL is spelled exactly the same — easy!
april.components: masculine noun · 'in April' = aprila · April Fools' Day = prvi april

maj.mnemonic: MAJ sounds like MY: MY favourite month, MAY.
maj.components: masculine noun · 'in May' = maja · Labour Day = prvi maj
maj.example_en: The first of May is a holiday.

junij.mnemonic: JUNIJ is JUNE with -IJ on the end.

julij.mnemonic: JULIJ, like Julius Caesar, who gave JULY its name.
julij.example_en: In July we go to the seaside.

avgust.mnemonic: AVGUST is AUGUST with a V.

oktober.mnemonic: OKTOBER with a K, just like Oktoberfest — OCTOBER.
oktober.example_en: In October the leaves are yellow.

december.mnemonic: DECEMBER, but the C sounds like TS — as always in Slovenian.

pomlad.mnemonic: PO + MLAD (young): when everything is YOUNG again — SPRING.
pomlad.example_zh: Pomlad je moj najljubši letni čas.

poletje.mnemonic: PO + LETO (year): the high point of the year — SUMMER.

jesen.mnemonic: "YES, THEN the leaves fall" — AUTUMN, JESEN.

zima.mnemonic: "SEE, MA, I can see my breath!" — it's WINTER, ZIMA.

praznik.mnemonic: From PRAZEN 'empty': offices stand EMPTY on a public HOLIDAY — PRAZNIK.
praznik.components: masculine noun 'public holiday, feast day' · 'to celebrate' = praznovati

rojstni dan.mnemonic: ROJSTVO (birth) + DAN (day) = BIRTHDAY, word for word.
rojstni dan.components: masculine noun 'birthday' · happy birthday = vse najboljše

božič.mnemonic: A BOW on EACH present — CHRISTMAS, BOŽIČ (from bog, God).
božič.components: masculine noun 'Christmas' · Merry Christmas = vesel božič

počitnice.mnemonic: From POČITEK 'rest': the time you REST — the HOLIDAYS.
počitnice.components: plural only 'holidays, vacation' · 'on holiday' = na počitnicah

hrana.mnemonic: HANNAH with a growling stomach — "HRRR-ANA!" — always thinking about FOOD.
hrana.components: feminine noun 'food' · uncountable: dobra hrana = good food

kruh.mnemonic: The starving ship's CREW shouts for KRUH — bread!
kruh.components: masculine noun · 'white bread' = bel kruh · genitive kruha

meso.mnemonic: MESO sounds like MISO, but it's MEAT.
meso.components: neuter noun 'meat' · 'I don't eat meat' = ne jem mesa (genitive)

piščanec.mnemonic: A CHICKEN goes "PEEP-SHCHA!" — PIŠČANEC (from pišče, chick).
piščanec.components: masculine noun 'chicken' (the bird and the meat) · genitive: piščanca

riba.mnemonic: A FISH full of tiny RIBS — RIBA.

jajce.example_en: I eat an egg for breakfast.

maslo.mnemonic: It takes MUSCLE to spread cold BUTTER — MASLO.

sadje.mnemonic: No FRUIT left in the bowl? SAD, YEAH — SADJE.
sadje.components: neuter noun 'fruit' (collective, no plural) · one piece of fruit = sadež

jabolko.mnemonic: "YEAH, a BOWL of APPLES and a COKE" — JABOLKO.

pomaranča.mnemonic: POM (apple) + ARANČA (orange): a golden apple — the ORANGE.
pomaranča.components: feminine noun 'orange' (the fruit) · the colour is oranžen · pomarančni sok = orange juice

zelenjava.mnemonic: From ZELEN 'green': all the GREEN things on your plate — VEGETABLES.
zelenjava.components: feminine noun 'vegetables' (collective, singular) · built on zelen (green)

krompir.mnemonic: Sacks of POTATOES piled up on a CHROME PIER — KROMPIR.
krompir.components: masculine noun 'potatoes' (singular, collective) · pražen krompir = fried potatoes

paradižnik.mnemonic: Once called the "apple of PARADISE" — PARADIŽNIK, the tomato.

solata.mnemonic: SOLATA and SALAD both come from Latin sal, 'salt'.
solata.components: feminine noun 'salad; lettuce' · 'a salad, please' = solato, prosim

juha.mnemonic: "YOO-HA!" — the hot SOUP is ready! JUHA.
juha.components: feminine noun 'soup' · goveja juha (beef soup) is a Sunday classic

riž.mnemonic: RIŽ is RICE with a buzz at the end.
riž.example_en: I cook rice for twenty minutes.

testenine.mnemonic: From TESTO 'dough': everything made of dough — PASTA.

pica.mnemonic: PICA is PIZZA — the letter c always sounds like 'ts'.

sladoled.mnemonic: SLADEK (sweet) + LED (ice) = sweet ice: ICE CREAM!
sladoled.components: masculine noun 'ice cream' · sladek = sweet, led = ice
sladoled.example_en: In summer I eat ice cream.

torta.mnemonic: A fancy TORTE — TORTA, a CAKE!
torta.components: feminine noun 'cake' (a big, decorated one) · small cakes and biscuits: pecivo

potica.mnemonic: Grandma's POTICA comes out of the oven in a round POT — the famous Slovenian nut roll.
potica.components: feminine noun · the traditional rolled cake, most often orehova potica (walnut)

sladkor.mnemonic: From SLADEK 'sweet': the sweet stuff — SUGAR.

zajtrk.mnemonic: ZA (for) + JUTRO (morning): food for the morning — BREAKFAST.

kosilo.mnemonic: A COZY, SLOW family LUNCH — KOSILO.
kosilo.components: neuter noun 'lunch' (the main meal of the day) · 'for lunch' = za kosilo

večerja.mnemonic: From VEČER 'evening': the evening meal — DINNER.
večerja.components: feminine noun 'dinner, supper' · 'for dinner' = za večerjo

lačen.example_en: I'm as hungry as a wolf.

žejen.mnemonic: THIRSTY in the hot sun, you look for SHADE — ŽEJEN.
žejen.example_en: I'm thirsty, do you have water?

dober.components: adjective 'good; tasty' (f. dobra, n. dobro) · the adverb is dobro

voda.mnemonic: VODA is vodka without the kick — plain water.
voda.components: feminine noun · 'a glass of water' = kozarec vode (genitive -e)

kava.mnemonic: KAVA rhymes with java — a hot cup of coffee!
kava.components: feminine noun · 'a coffee, please' = eno kavo, prosim (accusative -o)

čaj.components: masculine noun 'tea' · 'a tea, please' = en čaj, prosim
čaj.example_en: In the evening I drink tea.

mleko.mnemonic: Picture a whole LAKE of milk — m-LAKE-o, MLEKO!
mleko.components: neuter noun (ends in -o) · 'coffee with milk' = kava z mlekom
mleko.example_en: The milk is in the fridge.

sok.mnemonic: Don't spill JUICE on your SOCK — SOK.
sok.components: masculine noun 'juice' · jabolčni sok = apple juice

pivo.mnemonic: PIVOT to the bar for a BEER — PIVO (from piti, to drink).
pivo.components: neuter noun 'beer' · two beers = dve pivi

vino.components: neuter noun 'wine' · belo vino = white wine, rdeče vino = red wine

kozarec.mnemonic: A GLASS of wine for a COZY REST — KOZAREC.
kozarec.components: masculine noun 'glass' · 'a glass of water' = kozarec vode

skodelica.mnemonic: A little CUP scuttling across its saucer — SKODELICA.
skodelica.components: feminine noun 'cup' · skodelica kave = a cup of coffee

steklenica.mnemonic: From STEKLO 'glass': a thing made of glass — a BOTTLE.
steklenica.components: feminine noun 'bottle' · steklenica vina = a bottle of wine

natakar.mnemonic: He zooms between the tables, but he's NOT A CAR — he's the WAITER, NATAKAR.

račun.mnemonic: One look at the BILL and you sneeze: "RA-CHOO!" — RAČUN.
račun.components: masculine noun 'bill, check; account' · 'the bill, please' = račun, prosim

meni.mnemonic: MENI is the MENU — and also means 'to me'!
meni.components: masculine noun 'menu' · careful: meni is also 'to me' (meni je všeč = I like it)

miza.components: feminine noun 'table' · 'on the table' = na mizi

kavarna.mnemonic: From KAVA 'coffee': the coffee place — the CAFÉ.
kavarna.components: feminine noun 'café' · 'at the café' = v kavarni

restavracija.mnemonic: RESTAVRACIJA is RESTAURANT with a Slovenian -acija ending.
restavracija.components: feminine noun 'restaurant' · 'at the restaurant' = v restavraciji

hiša.mnemonic: He, the Shah, lives in a huge HIŠA — a house!
hiša.components: feminine noun · 'at home' = doma · 'in the house' = v hiši

stanovanje.mnemonic: From STANOVATI 'to live (in a flat)': the place you live — the FLAT, STANOVANJE.
stanovanje.components: neuter noun 'flat, apartment' · 'in the flat' = v stanovanju

dom.components: masculine noun 'home' · at home = doma · (going) home = domov

doma.example_en: Today I'm at home all day.

domov.mnemonic: MOVE back to the DOME: (going) HOME — DOMOV.
domov.components: adverb '(to) home' (answers 'where to?') · grem domov = I'm going home · at home = doma

soba.mnemonic: A ROOM with nothing in it but a SOFA — SOBA.
soba.components: feminine noun 'room' · 'in the room' = v sobi

kuhinja.mnemonic: From KUHATI 'to cook': the place you COOK — the KITCHEN.
kuhinja.components: feminine noun 'kitchen' · 'in the kitchen' = v kuhinji

kopalnica.mnemonic: From KOPATI SE 'to bathe': the room where you bathe — BATHROOM.
kopalnica.components: feminine noun 'bathroom' · the ending -lnica means 'a room for …'

spalnica.mnemonic: From SPATI 'to sleep': the room for sleeping — BEDROOM.
spalnica.components: feminine noun 'bedroom' · the same -lnica as kopalnica

dnevna soba.mnemonic: DNEVNA (day) + SOBA (room): the room you use by DAY — the LIVING ROOM.
dnevna soba.components: feminine 'living room' · dnevna comes from dan (day)
dnevna soba.example_en: The TV is in the living room.

vrata.mnemonic: VROOM-TA! The DOOR slams shut in the wind — VRATA.
vrata.components: plural only (!) 'door' · one door = ena vrata

okno.mnemonic: "Open the WINDOW?" "OK … NO, it's cold!" — OKNO.
okno.components: neuter noun 'window' · plural: okna · related to oko (eye)

postelja.mnemonic: "The POST? I'll TELL YA later — I'm still in BED!" — POSTELJA.
postelja.example_en: The child is already in bed.

omara.mnemonic: "OH, MARA, your clothes won't fit in the WARDROBE!" — OMARA.
omara.components: feminine noun 'wardrobe; cupboard' · 'in the cupboard' = v omari
omara.example_en: The clothes are in the wardrobe.

kavč.mnemonic: KAVČ is the COUCH, said the Slovenian way.
kavč.components: masculine noun 'sofa, couch' · 'on the sofa' = na kavču
kavč.example_en: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

luč.mnemonic: LIGHT makes everything LUCID — LUČ (like Latin lux).
luč.components: feminine noun 'light, lamp' · 'switch on the light' = prižgi luč

vrt.mnemonic: A GARDEN where everything is VERT, green — VRT.
vrt.components: masculine noun 'garden' · 'in the garden' = na vrtu
vrt.example_en: Grandpa is working in the garden.

televizija.mnemonic: TELEVIZIJA — TELEVISION with a Slovenian ending.
televizija.example_en: In the evening we watch TV.

računalnik.mnemonic: From RAČUNATI 'to calculate': the calculating machine — COMPUTER.
računalnik.components: masculine noun 'computer' · 'on the computer' = na računalniku

telefon.mnemonic: TELEFON — the same word, with an F.
telefon.components: masculine noun 'telephone' · mobile phone = mobilni telefon or mobitel

knjiga.mnemonic: A heavy BOOK resting on your KNEE — KNJIGA.

slika.mnemonic: A SLEEK PICTURE on the wall — SLIKA.
slika.components: feminine noun 'picture, painting, photo' · 'on the wall' = na steni
slika.example_en: The picture hangs on the wall.

nadstropje.mnemonic: NAD (above) + STROP (ceiling): what's above the ceiling — the next FLOOR.
nadstropje.components: neuter noun 'floor, storey' · 'on the third floor' = v tretjem nadstropju
nadstropje.example_en: I live on the third floor.

mesto.mnemonic: The TOWN centre is a busy MESS — MESTO.
mesto.components: neuter noun 'town, city; place' · 'in town' = v mestu

vas.mnemonic: A tiny VILLAGE among VAST fields — VAS.
vas.components: feminine noun 'village' · 'in the village' = na vasi (na, not v!)

ulica.mnemonic: "OOH, LISA, look at this STREET!" — ULICA.
ulica.components: feminine noun 'street' · 'in the street' = na ulici
ulica.example_en: There are many people in the street.

cesta.mnemonic: No SIESTA on a busy ROAD — CESTA.
cesta.components: feminine noun 'road' · 'on the road' = na cesti

trg.mnemonic: A TUG-of-war in the town SQUARE — TRG (no vowel, just a rolled R).
trg.components: masculine noun 'square, marketplace' · Prešernov trg is Ljubljana's main square

most.mnemonic: The BRIDGE that the MOST people cross — MOST.
most.components: masculine noun 'bridge' · Ljubljana's Tromostovje = the Triple Bridge
most.example_en: The bridge is a hundred years old.

trgovina.mnemonic: From TRG 'market': the place where you buy things — the SHOP.
trgovina.components: feminine noun 'shop, store' · 'to the shop' = v trgovino

trgovski center.mnemonic: TRGOVSKI (shopping) + CENTER (centre) — SHOPPING CENTRE, word for word.
trgovski center.components: masculine 'shopping centre, mall' · trgovski is the adjective of trgovina
trgovski center.example_zh: Trgovski center je odprt do devetih.
trgovski center.example_en: The shopping centre is open until nine.

tržnica.mnemonic: Also from TRG 'market': the covered MARKET hall — TRŽNICA.
tržnica.components: feminine noun 'market (hall)' · 'at the market' = na tržnici
tržnica.example_en: I buy fruit at the market.

pekarna.mnemonic: From PEČI 'to bake': the BAKERY — PEKARNA (the baker is a pek).
pekarna.example_en: I buy bread at the bakery.

lekarna.mnemonic: From LEK 'medicine': the shop for medicine — PHARMACY.
lekarna.components: feminine noun 'pharmacy, chemist's' · 'at the pharmacy' = v lekarni
lekarna.example_en: The pharmacy is around the corner.

banka.components: feminine noun 'bank' · 'at the bank' = v banki
banka.example_en: The bank is closed on Sundays.

pošta.components: feminine noun 'post office; mail' · 'at the post office' = na pošti (na, not v!)
pošta.example_en: I send the letter at the post office.

bolnišnica.mnemonic: From BOLAN 'ill': the place for ill people — HOSPITAL.

hotel.components: masculine noun 'hotel' · 'at the hotel' = v hotelu
hotel.example_en: The hotel is near the sea.

park.components: masculine noun 'park' · 'in the park' = v parku
park.example_en: The dogs are playing in the park.

cerkev.mnemonic: CERKEV comes from the same old word as KIRK and CHURCH.
cerkev.components: feminine noun 'church' · genitive: cerkve · 'in church' = v cerkvi
cerkev.example_en: The church stands on a hill.

muzej.components: masculine noun 'museum' · 'in the museum' = v muzeju
muzej.example_en: The museum is closed on Mondays.

kino.components: masculine noun 'cinema' · 'to the cinema' = v kino
kino.example_en: Shall we go to the cinema?

knjižnica.mnemonic: From KNJIGA 'book': the house of books — the LIBRARY.
knjižnica.components: feminine noun 'library' · a bookshop is knjigarna

grad.mnemonic: A GRAND CASTLE on the hill — GRAD.
grad.components: masculine noun 'castle' · Ljubljanski grad = Ljubljana Castle
grad.example_en: The castle is on the hill.

center.mnemonic: CENTER is CENTRE, with c said as 'ts'.
center.components: masculine noun 'centre' · 'in the city centre' = v centru mesta
center.example_en: I live in the city centre.

stavba.mnemonic: From STAVITI 'to put up': something put up — a BUILDING.

levo.mnemonic: LEAVE the road on the LEFT — LEVO.
levo.components: adverb '(on/to the) left' · adjective: lev, leva

desno.mnemonic: DEXTEROUS means good with your RIGHT hand — DESNO.
desno.components: adverb '(on/to the) right' · adjective: desen, desna

naravnost.mnemonic: From RAVEN 'flat, straight': keep going STRAIGHT ON — NARAVNOST.
naravnost.components: adverb 'straight on' · built on raven (straight, level)
naravnost.example_en: Go straight on to the bridge.

avto.mnemonic: AVTO is the AUTO — a CAR.
avto.components: masculine noun 'car' (despite the -o) · genitive: avta · 'by car' = z avtom
avto.example_en: I go to work by car.

avtobus.mnemonic: AVTOBUS — the old AUTOBUS, a BUS.

vlak.mnemonic: A long FLOCK of carriages being pulled — the TRAIN, VLAK (from vleči, to pull).

letalo.mnemonic: From LETETI 'to fly': the thing that flies — the AEROPLANE.

kolo.mnemonic: A WHEEL coils round and round — KOLO; two of them make a BICYCLE.
kolo.components: neuter noun 'bicycle; wheel' · genitive: kolesa · 'by bike' = s kolesom
kolo.example_en: I go to work by bike.

taksi.components: masculine noun 'taxi' · 'to call a taxi' = poklicati taksi

postaja.mnemonic: The POST where buses STAY a moment — the STOP, POSTAJA (from stati, to stand).
postaja.components: feminine noun 'station, stop' · 'at the stop' = na postaji

avtobusna postaja.components: feminine 'bus station' · avtobusna is the adjective of avtobus

železniška postaja.mnemonic: ŽELEZO (iron) → ŽELEZNICA, the 'iron road': the RAILWAY STATION.
železniška postaja.components: feminine 'railway station' · železo = iron, železnica = railway

letališče.mnemonic: From LETETI 'to fly' + -IŠČE 'a place': the place for flying — AIRPORT.
letališče.components: neuter noun 'airport' · -išče means 'a place for' (igrišče = playground)
letališče.example_en: The airport is far from the city.

vozovnica.mnemonic: From VOZITI 'to ride': the paper that lets you RIDE — the TICKET.
vozovnica.components: feminine noun 'ticket' (bus, train) · return ticket = povratna vozovnica

karta.mnemonic: A CARD, a CHART, a TICKET — anything printed on card is a KARTA.
karta.components: feminine noun 'ticket; map; (playing) card' · cinema ticket = karta za kino
karta.example_en: Do you have tickets for the concert?

potni list.mnemonic: POT (journey) + LIST (sheet): the sheet you need for a journey — the PASSPORT.

kovček.mnemonic: CHECK in your SUITCASE at the COVE — KOVČEK.

pot.mnemonic: Mind the POTholes on the PATH — POT.
pot.components: feminine noun 'way, path; trip' · have a good trip = srečno pot

daleč.mnemonic: Is it FAR? As far as DALLAS — DALEČ!

blizu.mnemonic: The ZOO is NEAR: just a quick BLI-ZOO away — BLIZU.
blizu.components: adverb 'near, close' · + genitive: blizu morja = near the sea

peš.components: adverb 'on foot' · iti peš = to walk (somewhere)

morje.mnemonic: MORE water than you can see — the SEA, MORJE (like French mer).
morje.components: neuter noun 'sea' · 'to the seaside' = na morje · 'at the seaside' = na morju

gora.mnemonic: A GORILLA sitting on top of a MOUNTAIN — GORA.
gora.components: feminine noun 'mountain' · 'in the mountains' = v gorah

jezero.mnemonic: YES, ZERO waves — a calm LAKE, JEZERO.
jezero.components: neuter noun 'lake' · Blejsko jezero = Lake Bled

reka.mnemonic: An old WRECK floating down the RIVER — REKA.
reka.components: feminine noun 'river' · the Sava and the Drava are the big ones
reka.example_en: The river flows through the town.

telo.example_en: Sport is good for the body.

glava.mnemonic: A GLOVE on your HEAD? — GLAVA.
glava.components: feminine noun 'head' · 'my head hurts' = glava me boli

oko.mnemonic: OKO looks like a face: two O-EYES with a K nose between them!

oči.mnemonic: "OH, CHEESE!" — your EYES light up: OČI.
oči.components: plural of oko, and it's feminine: modre oči = blue eyes

uho.mnemonic: "OOH-HO!" — you hear it with your EAR, UHO.

nos.mnemonic: NOS — NOSE, almost the same word.

usta.mnemonic: "OOH, STA-r!" — open your MOUTH wide in surprise: USTA.
usta.components: plural only (!) 'mouth' · 'in the mouth' = v ustih

zob.mnemonic: A TOOTH that makes you SOB — ZOB.
zob.components: masculine noun 'tooth' · plural: zobje · dentist = zobozdravnik
zob.example_en: I brush my teeth every day.

lasje.mnemonic: HAIR so long you could throw it like a LASSO — LASJE.
lasje.components: plural 'hair' (one hair = las) · 'she has long hair' = ima dolge lase

roka.mnemonic: HANDS up for the ROCKER — ROKA!
roka.components: feminine noun 'hand; arm' · two hands = roki · plural: roke

noga.mnemonic: A broken LEG — NO GO! NOGA.

prst.mnemonic: A FINGER to your PURSED lips: shh! — PRST.

trebuh.mnemonic: A whole TRAY of cake, and your BELLY says "BOO!" — TREBUH.
trebuh.components: masculine noun 'belly, stomach' · 'my stomach hurts' = trebuh me boli

hrbet.mnemonic: She lost HER BET and has to carry you on her BACK — HRBET.

srce.mnemonic: SR-CE has no real vowel, just a beating HEART: "sir-tse, sir-tse".
srce.components: neuter noun 'heart' · 'from the heart' = iz srca

zdravnik.mnemonic: From ZDRAV 'healthy': the one who makes you healthy — the DOCTOR.
zdravnik.components: masculine noun 'doctor' · a woman: zdravnica · 'to the doctor' = k zdravniku
zdravnik.example_en: I have to go to the doctor.

zdravnica.mnemonic: ZDRAVNIK + the female ending -ICA: a woman DOCTOR.

zdravilo.mnemonic: Also from ZDRAV 'healthy': what makes you healthy — MEDICINE.
zdravilo.example_en: Take the medicine after a meal.

bolan.mnemonic: ILL in bed with a BOWL of soup — BOLAN.
bolan.components: adjective 'ill, sick' (f. bolna) · 'I'm ill' = bolan sem

zdrav.mnemonic: NA ZDRAVJE — to being HEALTHY: ZDRAV!

boli me.mnemonic: "Don't BULLY ME, it HURTS!" — BOLI ME.
boli me.components: 'it hurts (me)' · the body part is the subject: glava me boli · plural: noge me bolijo

obleka.components: feminine noun 'dress; suit; clothes' · plural obleke = clothes

majica.example_en: In summer I wear a T-shirt.

srajca.mnemonic: A crisp SHIRT, almost the same sound — SRAJCA.
srajca.components: feminine noun 'shirt' (with a collar) · plural: srajce
srajca.example_en: Dad is wearing a white shirt.

hlače.mnemonic: TROUSERS with a broken LATCH — HLAČE.

krilo.mnemonic: A CURLY, twirly SKIRT — KRILO (it also means 'wing').
krilo.example_en: My sister has a red skirt.

jakna.mnemonic: JAKNA — a JACKET with the middle cut out.
jakna.example_en: Take a jacket, it's cold outside.

plašč.mnemonic: A long PLUSH COAT for winter — PLAŠČ.
plašč.example_en: In winter I wear a long coat.

čevlji.mnemonic: SHOES as shiny as a CHEVY — ČEVLJI.

kapa.mnemonic: KAPA is a CAP with an -a on the end.
kapa.components: feminine noun 'cap, hat, beanie' · plural: kape
kapa.example_en: In winter I wear a hat.

nogavice.mnemonic: From NOGA 'foot': what goes on your feet — SOCKS.
nogavice.components: plural of nogavica 'sock' · built on noga (foot)

torba.mnemonic: A BAG as big as a TURBAN — TORBA.
torba.example_en: The bag is on the chair.

barva.mnemonic: A BAR painted in every COLOUR: "WOW!" — BARVA.
barva.components: feminine noun 'colour' · 'what colour is it?' = kakšne barve je?

bel.components: adjective 'white' (f. bela, n. belo) · white wine = belo vino

črn.components: adjective 'black' (f. črna, n. črno) · black coffee = črna kava

rdeč.components: adjective 'red' (f. rdeča, n. rdeče) · red wine = rdeče vino

moder.components: adjective 'blue' (f. modra, n. modro) · also 'wise' in a different sense

zelen.mnemonic: New ZEALAND, all GREEN hills — ZELEN.
zelen.components: adjective 'green' (f. zelena, n. zeleno) · vegetables = zelenjava

rumen.mnemonic: A ROMAN coin of YELLOW gold — RUMEN.

roza.components: adjective 'pink' · it never changes its ending: roza majica, roza čevlji
roza.example_en: My daughter has a pink dress.

oranžen.mnemonic: ORANŽEN is ORANGE with a Slovenian ending.
oranžen.components: adjective 'orange' (the colour; f. oranžna) · the fruit is pomaranča
oranžen.example_en: In autumn the leaves are orange.

velik.mnemonic: A VERY big LEEK — VELIK, BIG!
velik.components: adjective 'big, large' (f. velika, n. veliko) · veliko also means 'a lot'

majhen.mnemonic: MY HEN is very SMALL — MAJHEN.

nov.mnemonic: A brand NEW star, a NOVA — NOV.
nov.components: adjective 'new' (f. nova, n. novo) · Happy New Year = srečno novo leto

lep.components: adjective 'beautiful, nice' (f. lepa, n. lepo) · 'nice weather' = lepo vreme

grd.components: adjective 'ugly' (f. grda, n. grdo) · opposite: lep

slab.mnemonic: A cold stone SLAB for a bed — BAD! SLAB.
slab.components: adjective 'bad' (f. slaba, n. slabo) · the adverb is slabo

dolg.mnemonic: A very LONG DOG, a dachshund — DOLG.
dolg.components: adjective 'long' (f. dolga, n. dolgo) · as a noun, dolg means 'debt'

kratek.mnemonic: A CRACKED pencil, now SHORT — KRATEK.
kratek.components: adjective 'short' (f. kratka, n. kratko) · opposite: dolg

visok.mnemonic: WE SOAK in a TALL tower of a bath — VISOK.

nizek.mnemonic: A LOW ceiling makes your KNEES ACHE — NIZEK.
nizek.components: adjective 'low; short (person)' (f. nizka, n. nizko) · opposite: visok

drag.mnemonic: Paying so much is such a DRAG — EXPENSIVE! DRAG (also 'dear').
drag.components: adjective 'expensive; dear' (f. draga) · 'dear Ana' = draga Ana

poceni.mnemonic: From CENA 'price': at a low price — CHEAP.
poceni.components: adverb/adjective 'cheap' · never changes its ending: poceni čevlji
poceni.example_en: At the market fruit is cheap.

vroč.mnemonic: A metal BROACH left in the sun is HOT — VROČ.
vroč.components: adjective 'hot' (f. vroča, n. vroče) · 'it's hot' (weather) = vroče je

topel.mnemonic: Nice and WARM, but not TOP-HELL hot — TOPEL.
topel.components: adjective 'warm' (f. topla, n. toplo) · 'it's warm' = toplo je

hladen.mnemonic: A fridge LADEN with COOL drinks — HLADEN.

mrzel.mnemonic: A frozen MORSEL of ice — COLD! MRZEL.
mrzel.components: adjective 'cold' (f. mrzla, n. mrzlo) · 'it's cold' (weather) = mrzlo je

hiter.mnemonic: The HEATER warms up really FAST — HITER.

čigav.mnemonic: WHOSE CHEEKY dog is this? — ČIGAV.
čigav.components: 'whose' (f. čigava, n. čigavo) · agrees with the thing owned

ali.mnemonic: Muhammad ALI asks a YES/NO question — or is it OR? ALI does both.
ali.components: starts yes/no questions (ali si utrujen? = are you tired?) · also 'or' (čaj ali kava)
ali.example_en: Do you drink tea or coffee?

in.mnemonic: Put this one IN AND that one too — IN means AND.
in.components: 'and' · joins words and sentences: kruh in maslo

pa.mnemonic: A gentle little AND or BUT: "PA ti?" — and you?
pa.components: 'and; but' (light contrast) · 'and you?' = pa ti? · never the first word
pa.example_zh: Jaz sem dobro, kako pa ti?
pa.example_en: I'm fine, and how are you?

ampak.mnemonic: "I'M PACKED, BUT I can't find my passport!" — AMPAK.
ampak.example_zh: Rad bi prišel, ampak nimam časa.
ampak.example_en: I'd like to come, but I don't have time.

ker.mnemonic: I do it BECAUSE I CARE — KER.
ker.components: 'because' · answers zakaj (why) · a comma comes before it
ker.example_en: I'm at home because I'm ill.

če.components: 'if' · a comma comes before it: pridem, če imam čas
če.example_en: I'll come if I have time.

zelo.components: 'very; very much' · zelo dobro = very good

še.components: 'still; more; yet' · še enkrat = once more · še ne = not yet

spet.mnemonic: They SPAT at each other AGAIN — SPET!

to.mnemonic: Point with your TOE: THIS one, IT — TO!
to.components: 'this, that, it' (pointing) · 'what is this?' = kaj je to?

ta.components: 'this' before a noun: ta avto (m), ta hiša (f), to okno (n)

moj.mnemonic: MOJ sounds like MY with a twist.
moj.components: 'my' (f. moja, n. moje) · it agrees with the thing owned

tvoj.mnemonic: Old English THY, Slovenian TVOJ — YOUR.
tvoj.components: 'your' to one person you say ti to (f. tvoja) · formal or plural: vaš

njegov.mnemonic: From NJEGA 'him': everything that belongs to him — HIS.

naš.mnemonic: OUR NOSH — the food is ours: NAŠ.

vaš.components: 'your' to several people or politely (f. vaša) · informal: tvoj

vse.mnemonic: VSE NAJBOLJŠE — "ALL the best!" VSE is EVERYTHING.

nekaj.mnemonic: There's SOMETHING on your NECK — I can EYE it! NEKAJ.
nekaj.components: 'something; some' · + genitive: nekaj denarja = some money
nekaj.example_en: I have to tell you something.

nihče.mnemonic: NOBODY fits in that tiny NICHE — NIHČE.
nihče.components: 'nobody' · the verb also takes ne: nihče ne ve = nobody knows

v.mnemonic: Just one letter: V — IN, INTO.
v.components: 'in' (+ locative: v hiši) · 'into, to' (+ accusative: v hišo)
v.example_en: The milk is in the fridge.

na.mnemonic: Put it NA the table — ON!
na.components: 'on' (+ locative: na mizi) · 'onto, to' (+ accusative: na mizo, na pošto)
na.example_en: The book is on the table.

z.mnemonic: Just one letter: Z — WITH. Before c č f h k p s š t it turns into S.

brez.mnemonic: A hot day WITHOUT a BREEZE — BREZ.

za.components: 'for' (+ accusative: za mamo) · 'behind' (+ instrumental: za hišo)

od.mnemonic: An ODD letter FROM an old friend — OD.
od.components: 'from (a person); since' + genitive: od mame, od ponedeljka

do.mnemonic: Walk all the way TO the DOOR — DO.
do.components: 'to, as far as; until' + genitive: do morja, do petka

pri.mnemonic: PRI — AT someone's place, right BY them.
pri.components: 'at, by' + locative: pri babici = at grandma's

k.mnemonic: Just one letter: K — TOWARDS a person. Before k and g it becomes H.
k.components: 'to(wards)' + dative, mostly for people: k zdravniku, h Katji

po.mnemonic: PO — AFTER, like POST-: po kosilu = after lunch.
po.components: 'after' (+ locative: po kosilu) · also 'along, around': po mestu

pred.mnemonic: PRED — BEFORE, like PRE-; also IN FRONT OF.
pred.components: 'in front of; before' + instrumental: pred hišo, pred kosilom
pred.example_en: I'm waiting in front of the school.

Slovenija.mnemonic: SLOVENIJA — the country with LOVE in its name: s-LOVE-nija.
Slovenija.components: feminine noun 'Slovenia' · 'in Slovenia' = v Sloveniji · 'to Slovenia' = v Slovenijo

slovenski.mnemonic: SLOVENIJA turns into the adjective SLOVENSKI — SLOVENIAN.
slovenski.components: adjective 'Slovenian' (f. slovenska) · no capital letter · 'in Slovenian' = po slovensko

slovenščina.mnemonic: Languages end in -ŠČINA: SLOVENŠČINA is the SLOVENIAN LANGUAGE.
slovenščina.components: feminine noun 'Slovenian (language)' · no capital letter · 'I speak Slovenian' = govorim slovensko

Slovenec.mnemonic: SLOVENEC — a SLOVENIAN MAN (people get a capital letter, languages don't).

Slovenka.mnemonic: SLOVEN- + the female ending -KA = a SLOVENIAN WOMAN.

Ljubljana.mnemonic: LJUBLJANA, from LJUB 'beloved' — the BELOVED capital.
Ljubljana.components: feminine noun · 'in Ljubljana' = v Ljubljani · 'to Ljubljana' = v Ljubljano
Ljubljana.example_en: Ljubljana is the capital of Slovenia.

nemščina.mnemonic: From NEM 'mute': long ago Slavs called the Germans 'the mute ones' — NEMŠČINA, GERMAN.

država.mnemonic: From DRŽATI 'to hold': what holds a people together — the COUNTRY, the STATE.

svet.mnemonic: Travel the whole WORLD and work up a SWEAT — SVET.
svet.components: masculine noun 'world' (also 'advice; council') · 'in the world' = na svetu

Evropa.mnemonic: EVROPA is EUROPE, with a V.

tujec.mnemonic: From TUJ 'foreign': someone from elsewhere — a FOREIGNER.
tujec.components: masculine noun 'foreigner' · a woman: tujka · foreign language = tuj jezik
